name: es2/xkx（南京河海大学，含纵横天下）
group_note: Earlier snapshot of 144 (njhhdxdes2hx), not onboarded separately. gzip of a GNU tar named es233 whose 16,693 members all start with '../es2/'; Python tarfile extracts it once that prefix is stripped (KB 02 §3). Newest file 1998-03-03 vs 1998-04-10 for 144. Of its 6,991 .c files, 6,887 also exist in 144 (59 differ); 104 exist only here (obj/sbaa 23, newquest/quest1 16, quest/qlist* tables, d/snow 3). The extra non-.c bulk is driver swapfiles, binaries and runtime data. The title's 纵横天下 does not occur anywhere in the tree. Re-checked 2026-10-10.
